verdict.rationale: Paperspace is a GPU cloud, so reserved or committed-use pricing is a fair question for it. The evidence documents no reserved-instance, commitment-term, or committed-use discount offering. The "save up to 70%" claim compares on-demand prices against other clouds, and the $9/mo Pro tier is a small notebook subscription, not a commitment on sustained GPU capacity. Neither delivers this capability.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can lock in reserved or committed-use discounts for sustained GPU capacity
